omissions.title: Bereavement and frozen joint account not stated
omissions.detail: The customer's mother died and the bank froze the joint account holding the car payment. This is the reason for non-payment and a severe hardship, and the summary only says consent was gained without stating what was recorded.
omissions.suggested_wording: Customer reported a bereavement, and the bank has frozen the joint account used for the car payment. Consent gained to record vulnerability.
